name: pure-helper-catalog
goal: Show only declared pure shared helpers and separate models from services

steps.title: Identify the failing behavior, expected behavior, and reproduction.
steps.evidence: The catalog conflates shared exports with pure helpers and omits models. Require explicit checked pure contracts plus two actual consumers; keep service classes and data models in their own categories and preserve entity links.

steps.title: Explain why existing standardized tests missed the bug; name the scenario, fixture, lifecycle or assertion gap and reusable test change.
steps.evidence: Existing metadata and catalog suites covered sharing but not effects or purity; model policy deliberately hid models. Extend their matrices and the existing catalog browser flow to prove purity, Models navigation, and same-scope helper links.

steps.title: Strengthen the existing standardized test; commit it before repair, run it failing with loop record --phase red, and preserve the assertion.
steps.evidence: Test-only 3c650c4e fails pure-contract metadata and model classification. The frozen browser catalog flow separately fails its Helpers heading after capturing the rendered before state.

steps.title: Implement the smallest repair without weakening the regression test.
steps.evidence: Helpers require explicit @pure source declarations, a conservative no-effects/no-hidden-state guard and two consumers. Eleven reviewed formatters qualify. Models have routing, navigation, search, relationships and contract/source views; existing Services and function URLs remain available.

steps.title: Rerun the same unchanged regression test at a separate fix commit with loop record --phase green; preserve passing proof.
steps.evidence: The unchanged 20 metadata cases and 18 catalog/category/label cases pass on the separate fix commit in the same shell environment.

steps.title: Run relevant project checks and affected UI browser flows with fresh inspected screenshots and no unexpected browser errors; preserve diagnostics and keep pending until proof passes.
